content.text: Check covers 2025 files, including the new one; passed.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `ba7a3bc 2025-12: add rows`.

Before committing I ran `scripts/check.sh`, and it passed. The check looks at every 2025 file in `data/`, so the new file was included.

The check script says the nightly import reloads only the month at the start of each commit message. That's 2025-12 here, which matches the new file. I left the original in `inbox/` because you asked me to add it, not move it.
